observation: Only configured endpoint/token and valid versioned key can call cache; read uses bearer header 60ms timeout and malformed/non-OK responses are unavailable.
Write has 250ms timeout returns boolean and callers may ignore it; no cache write blocks a catalog response.
HTTP is permitted only for loopback; HTTPS otherwise; cache envelope requires schema version projection hash metadata and data.
Fresh/stale shared data becomes a catalog projection and stale refreshes asynchronously; unavailable/miss calls source query.
Sidecar is loopback optional process and absent Tair configuration leaves primary site source-backed.
